design.caption: The same armored knight riding the same dark horse, carrying the same large red-and-gold flag in a misty landscape. Preserve knight, helmet, horse anatomy, reins, flag pattern and natural cloth motion. Same warm cinematic lighting and continuous action.
design.coordinate_semantics: Source-camera-relative offset divided by source-specific depth radius; negative Y is up. Source fitted motion retained. Independently authored path, no author trajectory copied.
design.motion_reference: Offset amplitude follows smooth median reconstructed foreground depth; source time/action unchanged
design.framing_revision: Retain the exact right-flank spatial path and body anchor; reserve extra late vertical field of view for the generated flag tip and horse legs. Original source already clips the flag top, so observed-point coverage alone cannot bound the novel cloth extent.
